zh: 设置页切分页时新的一页从它在分页条上所在的一侧滑入并穿过一点模糊，被换下的那一页朝另一侧滑出（约 0.25 秒），滑出的那张静止副本读屏与 Tab 键都碰不到。
en: Changing settings tabs slides the new one in from the side it sits on along the strip, through a short blur, while the one it replaces slides out the other way (about 0.25 s); the page sliding out is a still copy that neither a screen reader nor the Tab key reaches.
